reason: Project lead ACCEPTS 143.7 MHz as the FINAL integrated post-route timing result. T0050 A1 delivered a real [HW-IMPL] post-route at the 150 MHz target: WNS=-0.293 ns -> 143.7 MHz achievable, power total 15.99 W (dynamic 2.40 W + static 13.59 W). The -0.293 ns gap is an out-of-context-flow artifact (OOC clock-network skew 4.25 ns + the 2.0 ns off-chip output-delay budget on the AXI-master ports, which are NoC-internal in the deployed platform), NOT a core-logic limit (0.64 ns on the binding u_vit AXI-write-counter -> ddrOUT path). 143.7 MHz comfortably meets the 100 Hz control-loop deadline. The paper now reports 143.7 MHz [HW-IMPL] as the integrated timing headline, with the OOC-artifact rationale stated honestly in Threats (T4) and H1 reframed so its falsification threshold is 'closes post-route + gap >=40%' (met), not a brittle exact-MHz number.

decision.T0050_v2_aborted: The representative-on-chip-I/O-budget re-run (T0050_v2) is ABORTED and moved to _failed/. No WNS>=0 chase needed — 143.7 MHz is the accepted final number. Do NOT claim a platform-integrated higher Fmax.
